handback.title: A check failed before approval no longer blocks the merge
handback.summary: When re-runs are refused, checks from before a plan's approval still fail the merge gate.
handback.user_story: Approving a plan gives its pull request fresh checks, even when the app may not re-run them.

acceptance_criteria.text: A check that failed before a plan's approval no longer fails the merge gate when re-runs are refused.
acceptance_criteria.words: A check that ran before plan approval stays failed when the app cannot re-run workflows, so every merge gate fails again.
acceptance_criteria.no_edge_cases: A draft at approval already gets fresh checks today; no other normal-use case.

raises.label: Doubt: mostly fixed
raises.text: Since drafts, checks start only at the merge gate, after approval. Fix only the gap left? The plan assumes so.
raises.evidence: #616 merged after this was filed; `merge_gate` in `dokima/agent_autopilot.py` readies the draft. Gap: a ready PR re-planned with nothing pushed.
